card.name: Second digit inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the second digit of a two- or three-digit number, such as the 2 in 72 or 32. Most often seen in counts, denominators of fractions like (3/32), and formula constants.

modes.label: Denominator in a fraction
modes.description: Digit completing the denominator in an adverse-event count such as (3/24).

modes.label: Formula or sample size
modes.description: Digit inside a constant or case count in text, such as 72 in a CrCL formula or 43 cases.
